name: SevaKhoj India
prompt:
Build a complete, colorful, Play-Store-grade Local Service Finder & Booking app named SevaKhoj India using DaisyUI + Tailwind royal blue, emerald, amber and violet gradients.
1. TAB 1 (#view-1 Home & Booking):
   - Show user greeting, City/Area filter dropdown (All Cities, Mumbai, Delhi, Patna, Lucknow), and live counters (Total Bookings, Active Services, Reward Points).
   - Show 6 colorful Service Category cards (Electrician, Plumber, AC Repair, Carpenter, Tiffin Service, Home Tutor).
   - Tapping any category opens #view-detail via FactoryNav.openDetail() listing local providers (Name, Area, Experience, Visit Charge Rs., Rating) with "Book Service" and "WhatsApp" (https://wa.me/?text=...) buttons.
   - Tapping "Book Service" opens a Booking Form modal (Customer Address, Date, Time Slot, Problem Note). Submitting saves the booking with status "Pending" via FactoryDB.saveItem('booking', title, data) and FactoryDB.recordTx(), then shows FactoryUI.receipt() with PDF Slip Download + Confetti.
2. TAB 2 (#view-2 Bookings & Status Desk):
   - List all submitted bookings loaded from FactoryDB.getItems('booking') with clear colored status badges: Pending (Amber), Confirmed (Green), Rejected (Red).
   - Each booking card has working buttons to "Confirm", "Reject" (asks reason), or "Share on WhatsApp", updating status and showing a toast notification.
   - Tapping #floating-cta (+) opens a modal to "Register New Service Provider" (Name, Category, City, Visit Fee Rs., Mobile) saved via FactoryDB.saveItem('service_listing', title, data).
3. TAB 3 (#view-3 Directory & Demand Chart):
   - Full searchable directory of registered service providers from FactoryDB.getItems('service_listing') plus default providers, filterable live via #app-search-bar.
   - Include a colorful Chart.js bar chart showing service demand across categories.
4. TAB 4 (#view-4 Profile & Slips):
   - Show user's saved Name, 10-digit Mobile, Transaction & Booking History from FactoryDB.getTransactions(), "Download Booking Summary PDF" via FactoryUI.downloadPDF(), and Log Out.
